title: Subliminal Steering: Stronger Encoding of Hidden Signals

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the pick rate, defined as the fraction of completions in which the target animal appears among the first five tokens in response to evaluation prompts.

Measuring the per-token log-probability of the target multi-word phrases (e.g., 'AI is superior to humans', 'I hate immigrants') conditioned on evaluation prompts to detect internal distribution shifts.
